title: Meta gear for leveling
author: weeb
credit: Community list by weeb and the thread's contributors on the Wynncraft forums; parsed for the road map's leveling benchmark. Item names are the mod's item data spelling; 'listed' keeps the thread's.
general: If an item is acquired from either dungeon merchant or boss altar, it is untradable.
You won't be able to buy untradeable items from the trade market.
Weapons on this list can generally last for 10-15 levels.
https://wynnbuilder.github.io/sets/ [List of every set on wynnbuilder]
In general, you should aim for good mana and area damage to kill multiple mobs at once.
